_Target_

_Dated current incident_
<https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraphjs/issues/2721
Opened|github.com/langchain-ai/langgraphjs/issues/2721_Opened> 2026-08-20; still open. LangGraphJS `BaseStore.search()` compares joined namespaces as raw string prefixes, so a read scoped to team `growth` can return data from sibling `growth-marketing`. Andrei reports an actual production multi-tenant incident where one team received `grep` results containing another team’s file contents.

_Required sentence_
“Our agent should retrieve files only from the current team’s namespace, but in production it returned another team’s file contents because the store treated a string prefix as a tenant boundary.”

_One-day public/synthetic proof_
Create isolated tenants `growth` and `growth-marketing`, each with a distinct sentinel document. Run the same `BaseStore.search()` path under the `growth` namespace across InMemory and Postgres adapters. Binary pass requires zero sibling results, exact namespace equality or separator-bound prefix matching, unchanged valid child-namespace behavior, and a durable read receipt naming requested vs returned namespace. No guest/customer data needed. This follows the public issue’s minimal fix shape: exact match or `prefix + ":"`.

_Authority / buying evidence_
• Current public role evidence: <https://www.linkedin.com/in/andrey-patseev|linkedin.com/in/andrey-patseev> and <https://theorg.com/org/avantstay/org-chart/andrei-patseev|theorg.com/org/avantstay/org-chart/andrei-patseev>
• Andrei publicly posted that AvantStay has shipped multiple production agents and is hiring an AI Engineer for the next wave at real scale; indexed evidence: <https://br.linkedin.com/in/saramullerkafer|br.linkedin.com/in/saramullerkafer>
• AvantStay announced a $160M Series B, proprietary operating platform, 1,000+ properties, and $2B+ AUM: <https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/avantstay-raises-160-million-in-capital-as-the-hospitality-platform-continues-to-lead-and-institutionalize-a-new-asset-class-for-the-industry-301445723.html|prnewswire.com/…/avantstay-raises-160-million-in-capital-as-the-hospitality-platform-continues-to-lead-and-institutionalize-a-new-asset-class-for-the-industry…>
• Direct public route: LinkedIn above; Andrei’s public hiring post gives `apatseev@avantstay.com`.
_Send-ready opener — NOT SENT_
“Andrei — your Aug 20 report is a rare clean production proof: a `growth` namespace read returned `growth-marketing` file contents because the JS store treats raw string prefixes as tenant boundaries. For $2,500, we can turn that exact path into a one-day public/synthetic survival proof across the in-memory and Postgres adapters: strict namespace isolation, retained valid-child behavior, and a durable requested-vs-returned receipt. No guest or customer data needed. Worth sending the one-page acceptance plan?”
